passages.sermon: David wrote this psalm.\r\nThis psalm is a maskil.\r\nA maskil is a song that teaches wisdom.

passages.text: Blessed is he whose transgressions are forgiven, whose sins are covered.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
David was wise.
A person is blessed when God forgives his transgressions.
A person is blessed when God covers his sins.
passages.original: לְדָוִ֗ד מַ֫שְׂכִּ֥יל אַשְׁרֵ֥י נְֽשׂוּי־ פֶּ֗שַׁע כְּס֣וּי חֲטָאָֽה׃

passages.text: Blessed is the man whose iniquity the LORD does not count against him, in whose spirit there is no deceit.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
David was a king of Israel.
David was a servant of God.
God is the LORD.
God is holy and just.
God forgives sin.
A man is truly blessed when God does not count his iniquity against him.
This man has no deceit in his spirit.
This man is honest before God.
God looks at the heart.
God does not hold sin against the honest man.
passages.original: אַ֥שְֽׁרֵי אָדָ֗ם לֹ֤א יַחְשֹׁ֬ב יְהוָ֣ה ל֣וֹ עָוֺ֑ן וְאֵ֖ין בְּרוּח֣וֹ רְמִיָּה׃

passages.text: When I kept silent, my bones became brittle from my groaning all day long.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
David speaks about his own experience.
David kept silent about his sin.
David did not confess his wrongdoing.
David’s bones became brittle.
David felt weak inside.
David groaned all day long.
David suffered because he did not speak up.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ הֶ֭חֱרַשְׁתִּי בָּל֣וּ עֲצָמָ֑י בְּ֝שַׁאֲגָתִ֗י כָּל־ הַיּֽוֹם׃

passages.text: For day and night Your hand was heavy upon me; my strength was drained as in the summer heat. Selah Then I acknowledged my sin to You and did not hide my iniquity. I said, “I will confess my transgressions to the LORD,” and You forgave the guilt of my sin. Selah Therefore let all the godly pray to You while You may be found. Surely when great waters rise, they will not come near.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
God’s hand was heavy upon me day and night.
My strength dried up like in the heat of summer.
I felt weak and burdened.
Selah.
I acknowledged my sin to God.
I did not hide my iniquity.
I said, “I will confess my transgressions to the LORD.”
You, LORD, forgave the guilt of my sin.
Selah.
Let every godly person pray to You, LORD, while You may be found.
When great waters rise, they will not reach him.
passages.original: כִּ֤י׀ יוֹמָ֣ם וָלַיְלָה֮ תִּכְבַּ֥ד עָלַ֗י יָ֫דֶ֥ךָ נֶהְפַּ֥ךְ לְשַׁדִּ֑י בְּחַרְבֹ֖נֵי קַ֣יִץ סֶֽלָה׃ חַטָּאתִ֨י אוֹדִ֪יעֲךָ֡ וַעֲוֺ֘נִ֤י לֹֽא־ כִסִּ֗יתִי אָמַ֗רְתִּי אוֹדֶ֤ה עֲלֵ֣י פְ֭שָׁעַי לַיהוָ֑ה וְאַתָּ֨ה נָ֘שָׂ֤אתָ עֲוֺ֖ן חַטָּאתִ֣י סֶֽלָה׃ עַל־ זֹ֡את יִתְפַּלֵּ֬ל כָּל־ חָסִ֨יד׀ אֵלֶיךָ֮ לְעֵ֪ת מְ֫צֹ֥א רַ֗ק לְ֭שֵׁטֶף מַ֣יִם רַבִּ֑ים אֵ֝לָ֗יו לֹ֣א יַגִּֽיעוּ׃

passages.text: You are my hiding place. You protect me from trouble; You surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah I will instruct you and teach you the way you should go; I will give you counsel and watch over you.
passages.sermon:
God is my hiding place.
God protects me from trouble.
God surrounds me with songs of deliverance.
God says, “I will instruct you.
I will teach you the way you should go.
I will give you counsel.
I will watch over you.”
passages.original: אַתָּ֤ה׀ סֵ֥תֶר לִי֮ מִצַּ֪ר תִּ֫צְּרֵ֥נִי רָנֵּ֥י פַלֵּ֑ט תְּס֖וֹבְבֵ֣נִי סֶֽלָה׃ אַשְׂכִּֽילְךָ֨׀ וְֽאוֹרְךָ֗ בְּדֶֽרֶךְ־ ז֥וּ תֵלֵ֑ךְ אִֽיעֲצָ֖ה עָלֶ֣יךָ עֵינִֽי׃

passages.text: Do not be like the horse or mule, which have no understanding; they must be controlled with bit and bridle to make them come to you.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people.
He warns them.
Do not be like a horse.
Do not be like a mule.
A horse does not understand.
A mule does not understand.
They do not know what to do.
People must control them.
People use a bit and bridle to guide them.
The bit and bridle hold them back.
The horse and mule will not come close unless forced.
Do not be stubborn like them.
Listen and obey God willingly.
passages.original: אַל־ תִּֽהְי֤וּ׀ כְּס֥וּס כְּפֶרֶד֮ אֵ֤ין הָ֫בִ֥ין בְּמֶֽתֶג־ וָרֶ֣סֶן עֶדְי֣וֹ לִבְל֑וֹם בַּ֝֗ל קְרֹ֣ב אֵלֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: Many are the sorrows of the wicked, but loving devotion surrounds him who trusts in the LORD.
passages.sermon: The wicked have many sorrows.\r\nThe person who trusts in the LORD receives loving devotion.\r\nLoving devotion surrounds the one who trusts in the LORD.
passages.original: רַבִּ֥ים מַכְאוֹבִ֗ים לָרָ֫שָׁ֥ע וְהַבּוֹטֵ֥חַ בַּיהוָ֑ה חֶ֝֗סֶד יְסוֹבְבֶֽנּוּ׃

passages.text: Be glad in the LORD and rejoice, O righteous ones; shout for joy, all you upright in heart.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD is worthy of praise.
Righteous people trust in the LORD.
Righteous people should be glad in the LORD.
Righteous people should rejoice.
People with upright hearts should shout for joy.
People with upright hearts should celebrate.
passages.original: שִׂמְח֬וּ בַֽיהוָ֣ה וְ֭גִילוּ צַדִּיקִ֑ים וְ֝הַרְנִ֗ינוּ כָּל־ יִשְׁרֵי־ לֵֽב׃
